name: sparkles-text
title: Sparkles Text
description: A heavy heading with a handful of small four-point stars scattered over and around it, each fading and scaling in and out at random spots so the text keeps glittering.
use: A short heading needs a light magical accent without a full background effect.
avoid: Formal or data-heavy screens; the twinkling stars read as playful decoration.
a11y: The decorative stars are not hidden from assistive tech, and the twinkle loop and star shuffling ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The words sit large and bold in white on black, with a few very small four-point stars in purple and pink dotted around the letters. The stars are much smaller than the type and easy to overlook.
behaves: Each star shrinks to nothing and grows back at a slightly different moment, at random positions over the text, and the set is periodically replaced so new spots light up.
customise: Pass the words as children and set sparklesCount and the two colours; the size comes from the class name and the star shape is fixed in the source.
weight: light: About ten small SVG stars animating on repeat, plus a 100ms interval that reshuffles them.
